Klubi Futbollistik Besiana was a football club based in Podujevo, Kosovo. It was founded in 1984 and played in the second division of football in Kosovo, Liga e Parë. Legendary former Kosovo footballer Fadil Vokrri is one of founders of the club. KF Besiana won the Kosovar Superliga and the Kosovar Cup during the 2001/02 season.
